title: Grid and record: a past due date renders red「逾期 2 天」even when the record is 已还 — relative overdue styling reads the record's state or the view declares it
body:
## Source

Walked on 2026-10-16 on the AI-built loan list and its overdue view: 应还日期 for 平凡的世界｜刘思远 (状态 已还, 归还日期 今天) renders「逾期 2 天」in red; 解忧杂货店｜吴昊然 (状态 逾期) renders「逾期 4 天」the same way. The relative date cell formats any past date as「逾期 N 天」regardless of whether the thing it dates is still open; on a returned loan, a paid invoice or a closed task the red word is false.

## Target

1. The date cell's「逾期」form is opt-in by the view/column (a `dueDate` role on the column, or the object's stage field saying the record is open); a plain date column renders the absolute date (10月1日) with a muted「2 天前」tooltip.
2. When the column is a due date and the object has a stage field with a terminal kind (objectstack-ai/objectstack#23809) or a `returned_date`-style companion the view names, the overdue form appears only while the record is open.
3. The record page's date fields follow the same rule.

## File surface

`packages/plugin-grid/src/` date cell renderer, `packages/fields` date formatting, `packages/plugin-detail` field display, tests beside.

## Acceptance

1. Tests: a past date on a closed record renders the absolute date; on an open record with a due-date column it renders「逾期 N 天」.
2. Screenshot of the loan list on a dev instance.

## Evidence

Screenshots on the same branch and commit: [ai-runtime-overdue-view-unfiltered.jpg](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/blob/23ef817aa/docs/design/ai-build-2026-10-16/ai-runtime-overdue-view-unfiltered.jpg?raw=true).

<sub>Filed by the epic PM session `session_cdb7a717-def7-4e71-9988-f089fbaa18ff` from the 2026-10-16 build of a library-lending app (package `app.hcpl`: 图书 / 读者 / 借阅记录, a status kanban, an overdue view) on the test1016 tenant at https://os-4e4qa4.objectos.app (staging, zh-CN, the maintainer's browser pane at 1010 × 1119), through 用 AI 搭建 → the plan card → 开始搭建 → the Studio copilot → one change → the running app. The maintainer named the repositories, verbatim: 「ai 搭建的功能在 cloud仓库」「部分前端功能代码在 objectui 后端在 onjectstack」, and ruled on the design in chat: 「同意」 to the four points as drawn, then 「是否考虑浮出」/「属性好需要考虑选中每个元素的时候也要显示」, then 「按浮窗版定稿」.</sub>
